content: Prisma 7 (7.10.0 latest, 8.0.0-rc.13 in RC): Rust query engine removed for a TypeScript engine, ESM-only, prisma.config.ts required, prisma-client generator with mandatory output; Prisma has no first-class RLS/policy DSL and a generated client layer; Drizzle is closer to SQL and ships Supabase RLS helpers.
